reply_text:
I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is **10 June**, not 25 November.

- **Where the date comes from:** the shared brain holds Ilse's correction as the current fact. I checked it against #north-random, where on 14 Oct Ilse wrote that the date is 10 June and that the 25 November she'd posted in #north-team was "the wrong line." Marcus is a member of #north-random, so he could already see that correction. A renewal date also isn't a finance figure, so posting it in the team channel was fine.
- **Year:** Ilse didn't give one. 10 June 2026 had already passed when she posted, so the brain has it as "presumably 10 June 2027." I told Marcus to confirm the year with Ilse before he puts it in the account sheet.
- **Old reply:** my 14 Oct reply in #north-team still says 25 November. In his thread I told Marcus that reply is out of date, but I haven't edited it. Dana is in #north-team but not #north-random, so she may still be going by the old date.
